scope: Nonfolded Plus, Mul and Div LEFT expressions yielding a saved scalar TMP2, with a defined ordinary direct RIGHT CV8 in & | ^. The validated warning route uses fractional floats and a named two-call Deprecated handler; wider producers, references, objects and changed operand representations remain partial.
engine_basis: Zend/zend_compile.c::zend_compile_binary_op emits nonfolded Plus/Mul/Div results with zend_emit_op_tmp.
Zend/zend_vm_gen.php::zend_vm_set_opcode_handler swaps COMMUTATIVE operands when op1_type < op2_type; TMP2 LEFT/CV8 RIGHT therefore converts physical RIGHT first.

Zend/zend_operators.c::bitwise_or_function/bitwise_and_function/bitwise_xor_function call zendi_try_get_long in physical operand order; Zend/zend_vm_def.h BW helpers destroy TMP operands after the operation and check the pending Exception.
contract: The first conversion captures RIGHT 5.5 and warns at expression line24; H1 changes its live CV to 2.5 and the LEFT source to 99. The second conversion uses saved computed LEFT 12.5, then H2 changes RIGHT to 88. Normal results are strict integers 4/13/9 from 12 and 5, with two default Deprecated lines.
A supplied H2 Exception20 preserves the old outer result100, emits only the first default Deprecated, and reaches the same object catch. The quiet integral-float control has no handler or diagnostic.
